name: @claymod/extension
description: Claymod browser extension: describe a change, keep it as a mod.

scripts.e2e: bun scripts/webllm-libs.ts && wxt build && wxt build --mode e2e && playwright test
scripts.cypress: bun scripts/webllm-libs.ts && wxt build && bun scripts/cypress.ts
scripts.cypress:open: bun scripts/webllm-libs.ts && wxt build && bun scripts/cypress.ts open
scripts.screenshots: bun scripts/webllm-libs.ts && wxt build --mode e2e && playwright test screenshots
